Subsequent amendment of the Gold Reserve Act modified the original purpose somewhat to reflect termination of the fixed exchange rate system. Resources of the fund include dollar balances, partially invested in U.S. Government securities, Special drawing rights (SDRs), and balances of foreign currencies. print(f'June 30, 1996: {june_1996:,}')

print(f'Absolute relative difference: {percentage:.4f}%')
print(f'Rounded to 2 decimal places: {percentage:.2f}%')
"
